scripts.build: bun run sdk:build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run sdk:build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.extensions:build: bun run sdk:build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build
scripts.extensions:images: docker build -t peek-extension:local apps/extension-runner/runtime && docker build -t peek-extension-gateway:local apps/extension-runner/gateway
